item.title: November 27 at Nub’s Nob
item.description:
We’re open this weekend! 🎄 There isn’t enough snow for skiing yet, but the Lodge, General Store, Tune Center, Cafeteria, Pub, and Locker Roomare open today and Saturday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Stop by to: Think cold and snow! ❄️ The post November 27 at Nub’s Nob appeared first on Nub's Nob Ski Area - Northern Michigan .

Source: Nub's Nob (MI) blog.

item.title: Happy Thanksgiving
item.description:
Happy Thanksgiving from all of us at Nub’s Nob! Unfortunately, there isn’t enough cold air for a Thanksgiving Weekend opening. Even so, the Lodge, General Store, Tune Center, Cafeteria, Pub, and Locker Room will be open Friday and Saturday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. We hope you’ll stop by this weekend while we get ready […] The post Happy Thanksgiving appeared first on Nub's Nob Ski Area - Northern Michigan .

Source: Nub's Nob (MI) blog.
